individual_policies.evidence: Routine obstetric delivery services are reimbursed under global, delivery-only, or delivery/postpartum codes depending on services provided. Single vaginal delivery is paid at full allowance. Multiple vaginal deliveries allow the first delivery at full allowance and additional deliveries at 50% with modifier 59. Multiple cesarean deliveries do not receive extra reimbursement unless modifier 22 is supported by documentation. Combined vaginal and cesarean deliveries follow separate sequencing rules. Delivery-related services such as augmentation of labor, amniotomy, vacuum extraction, and prolonged services are bundled or not separately reimbursed.

Routine vaginal delivery claims are bundled into the global maternity/obstetric package. Delivery-related inpatient care, labor checks, induction, and short delivery admissions are not separately reimbursed unless the claim is billed with a partial-care delivery-only or delivery-plus-postpartum CPT code.

Multiple-birth vaginal deliveries are paid at 100% for the primary procedure and 50% for each secondary delivery when a multiple gestation diagnosis is on the claim and at least one delivery is vaginal.
